messages.subject: PTTEP | Upstream energy, responsible growth and stakeholder leadership
messages.body:
Dear PTTEP Executive Leadership Team,

PTTEP's international upstream portfolio requires strong technical execution alongside trusted government, regulator and community relationships. That intersection closely reflects my current work.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities span government and regulatory engagement, ESG, social performance, corporate coordination and executive stakeholder strategy across a large resource operation.

I lead multi-agency engagement around permits, inspections, official visits, environmental matters, operating commitments and community priorities. I also support governance around a large solar and battery-storage program and coordinated carbon-data readiness using physical operating records. This gives me a grounded perspective on responsible resource development and the institutional discipline needed around major projects.

I would welcome consideration for Thailand or international mandates in External Affairs, Government Relations, Sustainability, Social Performance, Strategic Partnerships or country leadership. I have attached a PTTEP-focused executive CV and would appreciate your forwarding it to the appropriate senior team.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
